definitions.explanation: A room where people wait, typically found in hospitals, clinics, stations, or offices.

examples.japanese: {病院|びょういん}の{待合室|まちあいしつ}で{順番|じゅんばん}を{待|ま}った。
examples.english: I waited my turn in the hospital waiting room.

examples.japanese: {待合室|まちあいしつ}には{雑誌|ざっし}が{置|お}いてある。
examples.english: There are magazines placed in the waiting room.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}の{待合室|まちあいしつ}で{電車|でんしゃ}を{待|ま}った。
examples.english: I waited for the train in the station's waiting room.

examples.japanese: {待合室|まちあいしつ}はとても{混|こ}んでいて、{座|すわ}る{場所|ばしょ}がなかった。
examples.english: The waiting room was very crowded and there was no place to sit.

examples.japanese: {歯医者|はいしゃ}の{待合室|まちあいしつ}で{名前|なまえ}を{呼|よ}ばれるのを{待|ま}っている。
examples.english: I'm waiting to be called by name in the dentist's waiting room.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{待|ま}ち{合|あ}い (waiting together) + {室|しつ} (room)

WHERE FOUND:
・{病院|びょういん}の{待合室|まちあいしつ} - hospital waiting room
・{歯医者|はいしゃ}の{待合室|まちあいしつ} - dentist's waiting room
・{駅|えき}の{待合室|まちあいしつ} - station waiting room
・{空港|くうこう}の{待合室|まちあいしつ} - airport lounge

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{待合室|まちあいしつ}で{待|ま}つ (to wait in the waiting room)
・{待合室|まちあいしつ}に{入|はい}る (to enter the waiting room)
・{待合室|まちあいしつ}が{混|こ}んでいる (the waiting room is crowded)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・ロビー - lobby (hotel, building)
・{控|ひか}え{室|しつ} - green room, backstage waiting area
・{待合|まちあい} - traditional Japanese tea house (different usage)
